retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic urban night scene featuring a group portrait in low-light street settings, anchored by a large, flowing monoline script title in the upper quadrant.

recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, atmospheric night scene on a city street where a group of figures are captured in a candid, slightly posed arrangement. The lighting is motivated by street lamps and car headlights, creating high contrast and deep shadows. A large, elegant monoline script title is positioned in the upper left, overlapping the dark background.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between elegant, fluid typography and gritty urban photography
Triangular composition of subjects within the lower two-thirds of the frame
Deep green and black shadows punctuated by warm skin tones and white highlights
Text placement in the negative space of the night sky
coreInvariants: Monoline script with long, sweeping flourishes
Muted, desaturated color palette with heavy blacks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures occupy the mid-ground, scaled to fill the lower half of the frame in a staggered horizontal line.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white script title in the top left corner acts as the primary entry point for the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright script, follows the vertical lines of the street architecture down to the central figures, and moves across their faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, upper-right quadrant provides breathing room for the busy textures of the street scene below.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest green and charcoal black (background/shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and pale beige (clothing and typography)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber and muted red (skin tones and distant car lights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the bright text/highlights and the dark environment.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely long, looping ascenders and descenders
Connected lowercase letters with high fluidity
Capital letters feature large, circular flourishes that overlap other characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'B' and 'D' integrated with sweeping circular loops
Terminal strokes on 'm' and 's' extend into long horizontal tails
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, expressive monoline script paired with a tiny, utilitarian sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Soft lens flare or light bleed from street lamps

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the monoline, flowing nature of the 70s lettering
Allows for the specific long-tail flourishes seen in the original

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, 1970s-style street photograph at night. Three men in vintage jackets and a flat cap lean against a dark pillar under a dim street light. The background shows a dark city street with blurred car lights and deep green shadows. Leave the top-left quadrant mostly dark and empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white monoline script title in the top-left corner. The script should have very long, looping flourishes that extend across the top. Add a small, two-line sans-serif subtitle in the far top-left corner above the script.

verificationChecks: Is the script monoline with uniform thickness?
Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Are the shadows deep green or charcoal?
Does the text occupy the top-left quadrant without crowding the subjects?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the portrait
Intensity of the green color cast in shadows
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Any specific brand logos on clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check that the script flourishes do not obscure the faces.
Ensure the color palette remains desaturated and moody.
Verify that the grain doesn't look like digital noise but like film stock.
Confirm the monoline script has no stroke-width variation.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Night Portrait + Monoline Script Overlay + 70s Film Grain
